newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Pekao leads PLN 362 mln power plant loan.
newsitem.headline: Polish Pekao leads PLN 362 mln power plant loan.

text.p: A banking consortium led by Polish state-owned Pekao SA signed an agreement to lend power plant Laziska SA 362 million zlotys to build a de-sulphurisation installation, Pekao's president said on Thursday.

The consortium also included state-owned PKO BP, Bank Slaski, Pomorski Bank Kredytowy SA, Bank Rozwoju Eksportu, Mitteleuropaeische Handelsbank AG, Bank Handlowy International SA in Luxembourg and Pekao's Israel unit, he said.
The president of Laziska Henryk Tymowski, also present, said the whole investment would cost 520 million zlotys.
